ops.body: Fixed by the v0.21.0 cut: Swift's own accept-side floor check was cut, not moved — Swift now mirrors only the client half plus a descriptor bridge forwarding accepted connections to the Go runtime, where the gate verified exactly one Floor implementation exists (internal/trust/trust.go:59-88, run unconditionally by Verify/VerifyAny before any Requirement). With one implementation there is no Go/Swift divergence for a fixture to pin, and the remaining cross-language wire-framing surface already shares a golden fixture across both suites.
